title: New Open World Steam Game Inspired by Classic GTA Set in the 70s
description: A new open world game on Steam is drawing direct inspiration from classic entries in Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto series, featuring a unique 70s setting.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A New Open World Contender on Steam

In the realm of open-world gaming, Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto series has long stood as the defining benchmark. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet GameRant, a brand-new game on Steam is taking direct inspiration from the classic entries of the iconic franchise.

## Embracing the 70s Aesthetic and Retro Gameplay

This newly surfaced Steam title centers its world around a distinct 70s setting. Based on available details, the game channels the retro atmosphere reminiscent of earlier GTA installments. For longtime fans who appreciate the foundational design choices of classic open-world crime games, this era-specific backdrop offers a notable dose of nostalgia.

## Broader Gaming Context and Expectations

As the gaming community continues to track major open-world releases like the anticipated GTA6, alternative titles that pay homage to the genre's roots often catch the eye of players looking for unique experiences. While a title of this scale naturally differs from a blockbuster production, its creative direction highlights the enduring influence of classic open-world design.

## Editor's Take

While all eyes in the open-world genre remain fixed on the horizon for GTA6, it is always refreshing to see developers draw inspiration from the classic era of the genre. Setting a game in the 1970s opens up fantastic stylistic possibilities, and though it may be a smaller project, it offers a fun throwback for fans of retro sandbox titles.
